google_review_notes: No login required. Tap Play on the main menu and tap the screen to flap; every feature (daily course, shop, sky skins, missions, settings) is reachable from the main menu. Arcade game with AdMob ads and optional in-app purchases. The free revive is an optional rewarded video.
apple_review_notes: No login required. Tap Play, then tap the screen to fly. To test IAPs, open the Shop from the main menu icon row. No demo account needed.
